items.html: And it is as I wrote above, in the matter of the existence of the Garon of ZA, from where it is made. And we said that the place of the Yesod is in the middle, between the two upper joints of Netzah and Hod; and since the two upper joints of Netzah and Hod ascended to the HGT of Aba and Ima, and there they remained always, the Yesod descended below, into the Bina of ZA. We find that this Yesod flies in the air, and has nothing on which to lean, for the place of its support and its hold is above, between the two upper joints of Netzah and Hod, as mentioned; and here it has fallen below, into the Bina of ZA. And thus it has nothing on which to lean.
